en.title: Ashen Harmonies, Still Eyes
en.premise: To ensure 'Public Tranquility,' citizens' emotions are suppressed, and every action must adhere to strict color regulations. Elai, a young Archivist, spends his days erasing 'Noise'—those who possess colors outside the prescribed spectrum. But one day, he discovers a 'Secret Map' drawn on a scrap of old paper hidden behind his issued management terminal. It is a path that shouldn't exist, leading to an era when the world once held color, far beyond the reach of the city's surveillance network.

zh.title: 灰色的谐调，静止的瞳孔
zh.premise: 为了维持“公共安宁”，市民的情感受到抑制，所有行为都必须遵循色彩规定。记录官青年埃莱（Elai）每天的工作就是抹除那些拥有规定外色彩的“噪音”。然而某天，他在配发的管理终端背面，发现了一张画在陈旧纸张上的“秘密地图”。那是一条本不该存在的路径，通往城市监控网无法触及的、世界曾经拥有色彩的时代。
